title: 第7章 雷祖现世第8章 九天元灵祈雨阵
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
其实林楠跟王成宇说的，只是其中的一个理由而已。
而另外的一个理由，就是“了解雷祖知识，还原神态与性格”
的提议，也被收录在了系统的建议栏中。
根据先前的情况来看，只要是他完成了相关的建议，扮演的完成度也会随之增加。
虽说增加的程度可能只是小数点后一位。
但是苍蝇腿再小，它也是肉不是？
所以林楠精神十分集中的，看着眼前关于雷祖的相关介绍。
王成宇看他的状态，就像是在刷高考题目似的，也就没再开口打扰了。
盯着电脑的林楠，每看一段都认真的记在了心里。
“雷祖又名‘九天应元雷声普化天尊’，居住在神雷玉府之中，他的面前有着三十六个雷鼓，这三十六面鼓代表着雷部三十六个雷司。
雷祖的面貌，是一个威严的男子。
手持打神驱魔鞭，两眼之间额头之上有着第三只天眼，这天眼可看破世间因果命数和善恶忠奸……”
这一下午的时间，林楠都在查着雷祖的相关资料。
并且硬生生的将大部分的内容都背了下来。
之所以这样做，除了要完成相应的建议之外，更是为了以防万一。
他的直播间，靠着扮演神明的噱头，吸引了不少好奇的网友。
等到明日真的穿上了铠甲，扮做雷祖的时候，肯定会吸引更多的人，带来更多的流量。
流量一多，肯定就会有人眼红。
难保不会有人在直播的时候挑刺，给他扣上什么也不懂的帽子。
正所谓肚子里有墨水，直播的时候也不会慌。

就算明天直播时，有人考他，他也能对答如流。
就在林楠抬手，合上面前的电脑时。
果不其然，耳边再次响起了系统的提示音。
【恭喜主人完成建议：了解雷祖知识
雷祖扮演完成度增加：0.5%
扮演完成度：0.6%
完成度不足1%，无法获得任何奖励。
林楠倚在椅背上，听着系统提示说完，然后思考起来。
“看来完成与扮演这一行为无关的其他建议时，增加的完成度十分的有限。”
“我明明已经完成了两个建议，却只积累了0.6%的完成度。
距离可以获得奖励的1%来说，这点增长还真是杯水车薪啊。”
不过林楠也没有继续为这件事而苦恼。
毕竟明天中午就要正式开始扮演了。
本着尽量还原的原则，再加上服饰与冕旒的加持，总能超过这1%了吧？
content_en:
In fact, what Lin Nan told Wang Chengyu was just one of the reasons.
Another reason is to "understand Lei Zu's knowledge and restore his demeanor and character."
The suggestions were also included in the system's suggestion column.
According to the previous situation, as long as he completes the relevant suggestions, the degree of completion of the role will also increase accordingly.
Although the degree of increase may only be one decimal place.
But no matter how small the fly's legs are, they are still meat, right?
Therefore, Lin Nan was very focused and looked at the introduction about Lei Zu in front of him.
Wang Chengyu looked at his state, as if he was studying college entrance examination questions, so he didn't bother him anymore.
Lin Nan stared at the computer, carefully remembering every paragraph he read.
"Leizu is also known as the 'Nine Heavens Yingyuan Thunder Universal Transformation Heavenly Lord'. He lives in the Divine Thunder Jade Mansion. In front of him are thirty-six thunder drums. These thirty-six drums represent the thirty-six thunder divisions of the Lei Department.
Lei Zu's appearance was that of a majestic man.
Holding a whip to beat gods and exorcise demons, there is a third heavenly eye on the forehead between the two eyes. This heavenly eye can see through the cause and effect of the world, as well as good and evil, loyalty and traitor..."
Throughout the afternoon, Lin Nan was looking up relevant information about Lei Zu.
And he memorized most of the contents by heart.
The reason for doing this is not only to complete the corresponding suggestions, but also to be just in case.
In his live broadcast room, he attracted many curious netizens by pretending to be a god.
When I really put on the armor tomorrow and pretend to be Leizu, it will definitely attract more people and bring more traffic.
Once there is a lot of traffic, some people will definitely be jealous.
There's no guarantee that someone won't find fault with him during the live broadcast and label him as someone who doesn't understand anything.
As the saying goes, if you have ink in your belly, you won’t panic during the live broadcast.
Even if someone tests him during the live broadcast tomorrow, he will still be able to answer fluently.
Just when Lin Nan raised his hand and closed the computer in front of him.
Sure enough, the system prompt sounded again.
[Congratulations to the host for completing the suggestion: Understand the knowledge of Lei Zu
Lei Zu’s role completion degree increased: 0.5%
Role play completion: 0.6%
If the completion level is less than 1%, you will not be able to receive any rewards.
Lin Nan leaned on the back of the chair, listened to the system prompts, and then started thinking.
"It appears that completing other suggestions unrelated to the role-playing behavior adds only a limited amount of completion."
“I have obviously completed two suggestions, but only accumulated 0.6% completion rate.
Compared with 1% of the rewards that can be obtained, this increase is really a drop in the bucket. "
However, Lin Nan did not continue to worry about this matter.
After all, the performance will officially start at noon tomorrow.
Based on the principle of restoring as much as possible, coupled with the blessing of clothing and crowns, it can always exceed this 1%, right?
